verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs describe connecting it to your Git provider and having it automatically review every pull request directly in the PR. They also name GitHub and GitLab as supported providers for native PR labels, and mention in-PR chat and discussing or dismissing findings. A community user confirms running Qodo's review bot on PRs for two years. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that findings post as native inline (line-level) comments, any evidence of the 'within minutes' turnaround, and explicit description of the GitHub/GitLab app installation flow.
